name: Long/Short ExpertMACD
summary: This EA is a MACD-based long/short trading expert that extends the standard MQL5 CExpert framework with a custom CLongShortExpertModified class. It generates trade signals from MACD crossover logic and allows the user to restrict trading to long-only, short-only, or both directions. The EA uses no trailing stop and no money management module, relying solely on fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels for trade exits.
summary_zh: 该EA是基于MACD指标的多空交易专家，通过自定义的CLongShortExpertModified类扩展了标准MQL5 CExpert框架。它根据MACD交叉逻辑产生交易信号，并允许用户限制仅做多、仅做空或双向交易。该EA不使用移动止损和资金管理模块，仅依赖固定的止盈止损水平来退出交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于MACD指标的动量信号，通过快线与慢线的交叉来判断市场方向并产生入场信号。入场条件由CSignalMACD模块决定，当MACD主线上穿信号线时做多，下穿时做空，同时受Inp_Allowed_Positions参数控制是否允许双向交易。出场条件采用固定止盈和止损值，分别由Inp_Signal_MACD_TakeProfit和Inp_Signal_MACD_StopLoss参数设定，没有使用移动止损（CTrailingNone）。仓位管理方面，由于使用CMoneyNone模块，EA不执行任何动态仓位调整或资金管理，手数需在EA属性中手动设置。资金管理完全缺失，这意味着交易者需要自行控制风险敞口，EA不会根据账户余额或风险比例自动计算仓位大小。整体来看，这是一个结构清晰但功能相对基础的MACD动量跟踪系统。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept of this EA is based on momentum signals from the MACD indicator, using crossover of the fast and slow MACD lines to determine market direction and generate entry signals. Entry conditions are determined by the CSignalMACD module: a long position is opened when the MACD main line crosses above the signal line, and a short position when it crosses below, with the Inp_Allowed_Positions parameter controlling whether long, short, or both directions are permitted. Exit conditions use fixed take-profit and stop-loss values set by Inp_Signal_MACD_TakeProfit and Inp_Signal_MACD_StopLoss respectively, with no trailing stop functionality (CTrailingNone). Position sizing is not dynamically managed since the EA uses CMoneyNone, meaning lot size must be manually configured in the EA properties. Money management is entirely absent, so the trader must manually control risk exposure as the EA does not auto-calculate position sizes based on account balance or risk ratios. Overall, this is a cleanly structured but relatively basic MACD momentum-following system.

parameters.name: Inp_Allowed_Positions
parameters.description: 允许的持仓方向（仅做多/仅做空/双向）

pros: 基于标准MQL5 Expert框架开发，代码结构清晰规范，易于理解和维护
支持多空方向控制（Inp_Allowed_Positions），灵活性高，可适应不同市场观点
使用标准库模块（CSignalMACD等），模块化设计便于替换或扩展信号源、止损追踪和资金管理组件
pros_en: Built on the standard MQL5 CExpert framework with clean, well-structured code that is easy to understand and maintain
Supports position direction control (Inp_Allowed_Positions), offering high flexibility to adapt to different market views
Uses standard library modules (CSignalMACD, etc.) with a modular design that makes it easy to replace or extend signal, trailing, and money management components
cons: 完全没有资金管理模块（CMoneyNone），不会根据账户风险自动调整仓位大小
没有移动止损机制（CTrailingNone），盈利交易无法通过追踪止损锁定浮动利润
止损点数（20）小于止盈点数（50）但比例偏低，MACD信号在震荡市中容易产生频繁假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏点差过滤和新K线检测机制，在流动性差或点差大的环境下可能产生不利成交
cons_en: No money management module at all (CMoneyNone), so position sizes are never auto-adjusted based on account risk
No trailing stop mechanism (CTrailingNone), meaning profitable trades cannot lock in floating gains through trailing stops
Stop-loss (20) is smaller than take-profit (50) but the ratio is modest, and MACD signals can generate frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
Lacks spread filtering and new bar detection, which may result in unfavorable fills in low-liquidity or high-spread environments
improvements: 添加动态资金管理模块（如MoneyFixedMargin或MoneyFixedRisk），根据账户余额和风险比例自动计算仓位大小
添加移动止损模块（如TrailingFixedPips或TrailingMA），以在趋势行情中锁定更多利润
增加点差过滤和新K线检测逻辑，避免在高点差或同一K线内重复开仓
improvements_en: Add a dynamic money management module (e.g., MoneyFixedMargin or MoneyFixedRisk) to auto-calculate position sizes based on account balance and risk ratio
Add a trailing stop module (e.g., TrailingFixedPips or TrailingMA) to lock in more profit during trending moves
Add spread filtering and new bar detection logic to avoid opening positions during high spreads or repeated entries within the same bar

risk_points: 无资金管理模块，仓位大小完全依赖手动设置，存在过度杠杆风险
无移动止损，趋势反转时可能将盈利交易变为亏损
MACD在震荡市中容易产生虚假信号导致频繁止损
risk_points_en: No money management module means position sizing relies entirely on manual configuration, posing over-leveraging risk
No trailing stop means profitable trades can turn into losses when the trend reverses
MACD tends to generate false signals in ranging markets, leading to frequent stop-outs
